entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned counsel for the State.

2. The present application has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Khunti P.S.
Case No.94 of 2019 (corresponding to G.R. No.653 of 2021, registered for the offence under Sections 420, 409 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned C.J.M., Khunti.
3. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicants and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.

It has been submitted that the applicants are posted as Member Seeds Production Society Committee,
Dadigutu.
Further, one of the co- accused namely Jaitu Tuti has already been granted bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 02.03.2021 in A.B.A. No.272 of 2021.
On the above basis, prayer for anticipatory bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Considering the above facts and the fact that the applicants are ladies, the applicants are granted privilege of anticipatory bail.

Hence, in the event of their arrest or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, they shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Khunti, in connection with Khunti P.S. Case No.94 of 2019 (corresponding to G.R. No.653 of 2021, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2)
Cr. P.C. and also on the condition that the applicants will submit self-attested photocopies of their Aadhaar Cards and also submit their mobile numbers before the learned court below which she/he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
